functions.name: pitSelectionStateMachine
functions.summary: Per-frame pit-selection commentary state machine. Guarded by race-active flag, track-condition state, player-vehicle flag, and race phase. Computes a requested zone index (v7) from clamped input a4 and a projected zone index (v8) from the player vehicle's distance projection, then dispatches on event/state argument a2 through a jump table: state 0 deactivates a zone (clearing this[v7+316], emitting zone-specific event codes 133/135/137 or the common 126), state 2 activates a zone (committing this[v7+316]=2, firing preceding event pairs via BooleanOROfTwoChecks), state 3 emits generic event 131, state 5 emits player pit-entry sub-events 123-125 when the player vehicle matches a5. Built entries are inserted into session event table flt_5EA618 through the shared sentinel-guarded tail.

Clamp input a4 to [0.0, flt_5EA3FC]: negative values become 0.0, values above flt_5EA3FC are capped to it.

DistanceProjectionCalc computes a distance projection from the player vehicle (dword_7C54E8 + 12) and stores the double result in v11.
FloatRangeIndexLookup maps the clamped requested input a4 to a zone index v7.
FloatRangeIndexLookup maps the projected distance v11 to a zone index v8.
v9 records whether the projected zone index equals the requested zone index (v8 == v7); used to gate re-entry events across state 0 and state 2 paths.
Dispatch on event/state argument a2 through jump table jpt_41B47F: state 0 deactivates a zone, state 2 activates a zone, state 3 emits a generic event, state 5 handles player pit entry.
State 0 pre-check: the per-zone activation flag this[v7 + 316] must equal 2 and ScoringGateSelector(v7) must return false before the zone can be deactivated.
Deactivate the zone: clear the per-zone flag this[v7 + 316] to 0.
State 0 zone-event path proceeds only when session type dword_7C56A4 equals 7 and race phase dword_7C56A8 is not 5; otherwise control falls through to the shared tail.
State 0, zone index 0: guarded by projected zone v8 not being 1; StateCheckedVirtualDispatch then ArraySearchReturningIndex evaluate whether event 138 already exists in session table flt_5EA618.
State 0, zone index 0 fill: DriverDataTableLookupAndTimeConversion builds an event 137 entry (v13, 137, -1, -1, -1, -1, -2.0, -2.0).

State 0, zone index 1 (v7 == 1): guarded by projected zone v8 not being 2; StateCheckedVirtualDispatch then ArraySearchReturningIndex evaluate whether event 134 already exists in session table flt_5EA618.

State 0, zone index 1 fill: DriverDataTableLookupAndTimeConversion builds an event 133 entry (v13, 133, -1, -1, -1, -1, -2.0, -2.0); when zones match (v9) an event 126 entry is filled instead via LABEL_37.

State 0, zone index 2 (v7 == 2): guarded by projected zone v8 being 1; StateCheckedVirtualDispatch then ArraySearchReturningIndex evaluate whether event 136 already exists in session table flt_5EA618.

State 0, zone index 2 fill: DriverDataTableLookupAndTimeConversion builds an event 135 entry (v13, 135, -1, -1, -1, -1, -2.0, -2.0); when zones match (v9) an event 126 entry is filled instead via LABEL_37.
LABEL_37 common re-entry fill: DriverDataTableLookupAndTimeConversion builds an event 126 entry (v13, 126, -1, -1, -1, -1, -2.0, -2.0) for the zone-matching case.
Shared tail (LABEL_67): if the first entry field LODWORD(v13[0]) is not the -1 sentinel, InsertDriverTableEntry inserts the entry into session table flt_5EA618, then the function returns.

State 2 activation condition: triggered when the projected zone moved (v8 != v7) or the projected distance plus 50.0 falls below the requested a4; per-zone sub-branches additionally gate on v8 and on FloatWrapTableInterpolation(v11, 0) producing a value below 0.89999998.

State 2 per-zone event churn: BooleanOROfTwoChecks fires the preceding event pair on session table flt_5EA618 (137/134 for zone 0, 133/136 for zone 1, 135/138 for zone 2), ArraySearchReturningIndex clears the target event (138, 134 or 136), and DriverDataTableLookupAndTimeConversion fills the matching code (138, 134 or 136).
State 2 commit: set the per-zone activation flag this[v7 + 316] to 2, then reach the shared insertion tail.
State 3: DriverDataTableLookupAndTimeConversion builds a generic event 131 entry (v13, 131, -1, -1, -1, -1, -2.0, -2.0), then control reaches the shared tail.
State 5 player pit entry: proceeds only when player vehicle dword_7C54E8 is nonzero and equals the passed vehicle a5, then switches on sub-type a6.

State 5 sub-types: a6 == 1 fills event 123; a6 == 2 fires BooleanOROfTwoChecks for 123 then fills event 124; a6 == 3 fires BooleanOROfTwoChecks for 123 and 124 then fills event 125, all on session table flt_5EA618.

functions.name: PitRaceStatusMessageDispatcher
functions.summary: Dispatches pit/race status driver-table messages (IDs 506-513) when the race is active (dword_7D0308) and the track-condition state (flt_7CF3C8) is non-zero. functions.name: PitExit
functions.summary: Dispatches a pit-exit commentary message for the car whose driver number (a2+1) is leaving the pit lane. Guards on race-active (dword_7D0308) and track condition (flt_7CF3C8), then locates the car slot in the vehicle array (dword_5F0738, stride 4656) by its first dword. Selects an audio message id (default 397, range 516-535) from the slot's relationship classification (this[v4] in 1..3), the car's relative race position against the player's position (dword_7C54E8+16480), position-fraction thresholds (v11/dword_5C329C), parity, and championship mode (dword_7D0410). A random remap may replace some ids via a jump table (jpt_41C243). The chosen entry is emitted through DriverDataTableLookupAndTimeConversion and InsertDriverTableEntry.

operations.description: If race-active flag dword_7D0308 is zero, return without dispatching any commentary.
If track condition state flt_7CF3C8 equals 0.0, return without dispatching any commentary.
Initialize locals: driver number v3 = a2 + 1 (also stored to v11), slot counter v4 = 0.
If vehicle count dword_5C329C is zero, skip the slot lookup and message dispatch.
Iterate the vehicle array from base dword_5F0738 with element stride 4656, comparing each slot's first dword to v3 (the driver number), advancing v4 per step.
If the slot counter v4 reaches vehicle count dword_5C329C without a driver-number match, return without dispatching.
Set default message id v6 = 397 and driver index v13 = a2 + 1, then initialize the local entry struct v12.
StructInitWithSentinelValues(v12) fills the driver-table entry struct with sentinel/default values.
If championship mode dword_7D0410 equals 2, skip all relationship-specific message selection and keep the default id 397.
Branch on the matched slot's relationship classification this[v4]: value 1 (player-lead group), value 2 (rival group), value 3 with mode 4 (constructor-rival group).

For classification 1: id 516 when v3 == 1; otherwise compute position fraction v10 = v11 / dword_5C329C and select id 517, 518, or 519 from thresholds v10>=0.5, v10<=2.0, v3>10, and the condition dword_5C329C*2/3 > v11 with dword_5C329C > 11.

For classification 2: read player's race position v9 = *(dword_7C54E8 + 16480); select id 521/523/524 from the sign of (v3 - v9), odd/even parity (v3 % 2), and distance > 3, using the expression (distance > 3) + 524 or (distance > 3) + 521.

For classification 3 with dword_7D0410 == 4: read player's race position v8 = *(dword_7C54E8 + 16480); select id 528/531/534/535 from relative position and parity, base expression (v3 >= v8 + 3) + 528 or (v3 + 3 <= v8) + 534.
If RandLCGRandomNumberGenerator(v7) returns odd, remap the selected id through the jump table jpt_41C243: 528->526, 529->527, 531->530, 534->532, 535->533; default case sets v13 = v3.

DriverDataTableLookupAndTimeConversion(v12, v6, dword_5F0F74[4656 * v4], v13, -1, -1, -2.0, -2.0) fills the entry with the selected message id, the slot's driver identifier, and the driver/time index; -1 and -2.0 are fixed default arguments.
InsertDriverTableEntry(flt_5EA618, v12) appends the completed entry to the driver-table at flt_5EA618.

functions.name: StringCapitalizer
functions.summary: In-place title-case conversion of a NUL-terminated byte string. Capitalizes the first character if it is lowercase (this[0] in 97..122, subtract 32), then walks from this[1] and, for each character, inspects the previous character: if the previous character is a non-letter (outside 'a'-'z' and 'A'-'Z') the current character is uppercased when lowercase, otherwise the current character is lowercased when uppercase. Other characters pass through unchanged. Returns the trailing NUL byte. Called by SettingsCopySetupFileCopy (00432220).

Guard 0: if *this (this+0x0) is >= 97 ('a') it may be a lowercase letter; combined with the upper bound 122 ('z') the first character is lowercase.

Iterate from i = this + 1 while the current character (*i) is non-zero; the result value tracks the current character.
Guards 1 and 2: read the previous character v4 = *(i - 1); it is a non-letter when v4 < 97 (not a lowercase letter) and v4 < 65 (not any letter), i.e. outside 'A'-'Z' and 'a'-'z'.

Letter predecessor branch: if the current character *i is not in 65..90 ('A'-'Z', uppercase) skip it; otherwise it is an uppercase letter to be decapitalized.

Return the trailing NUL byte (result = this[1] initially, updated to *++i as the loop advances); the return value is not used for case conversion.
